description:
These are the most disturbing fungi known to science: a fungus that makes cicadas lose half their body and keep flying, one that poses dead flies as bait, a frog-killer linked to 90 presumed species extinctions, a bat plague, an earthquake outbreak, a cursed tomb, and the one deadly fungus that may be learning to survive our body heat. Each one gets a turn with Doug.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
